prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: single transparent dialogue head portrait for a dark medieval RPG, designed to read at 74 by 100 pixels. Make a substantive newly drawn portrait, not a crop of the reference body.
Input images in order: 1 is Kofu's approved identity mother image; 2 Mara, 3 Iwo, 4 Leiya, 5 Tore are STYLE AND HEAD-FRAMING references only. Do not copy their identity.
Subject: Kofu / 蔻芙 / OSB-NPC-KOFU, an adult woman in her late twenties, a forceful honest vegetable grower with her own wishes. Preserve the mother's adult squarer lower jaw, longer straight nose, fuller straight closed mouth, dark brown side-part hair and TWO simple braids, visible ears and independent restrained gaze. Her latest character card overrides the old mother's missing costume detail: she wears a plain SELF-DYED PALE BLUE HEADSCARF over the crown/back of her hair, with side hair and both braids still clear, warm wheat-tanned skin, and her mother's resized old tan apron over a faded muted green work dress. Show only tiny neckline/apron-strap hints at the very bottom, not a bust.
Style: emulate the four low-resolution reference portraits, coarse intentionally constructed angular pixel clusters, connected broad nose and cheekbone planes, earth palette, dark broken contour, hard-edged contiguous shapes. Large sober facial structure; SMALL narrow dark eyes, only 1-2 muted warm-gray sclera pixels at logical size. Short brows without winged lashes. Adult, practical, slightly firm expression; no cute teenager, no pretty generic doll face, no glossy eyes, no eyeliner, no smooth airbrush or tiny speckle texture.
Composition: portrait canvas aspect 74:100. Entire head, headscarf knot silhouette, both ears and BOTH BRAID ENDS remain wholly inside frame with genuinely transparent clearance on all four sides. A very large face, cheekbone width around 60% of canvas, face from brow to chin about half canvas height; head-and-hair overall fills almost all height. Very short visible neck and a narrow collar occupying only the lowest 10-12%. No broad shoulders, chest, hands or props. Slight three-quarter toward viewer left as mother. Compact hair at shoulders rather than widening the bust. Nothing cut by canvas edge; about 4-5% clear margin beyond every hair/scarf extremity.
Output: exactly one isolated head portrait on true transparent alpha. At most 32 colors intended, binary sharp transparency, no background, no border, no text or labels, no collage. Distinct grown-up personal likeness and readable light/shadow clusters matter more than decorative detail. Do not depict wedding, land transfer, water-jar, romance, outcome, jewelry or additional invented accessories.
